cases.question: How can I ask ChatGPT about AYA from this sample?
cases.expected_behavior: Enter an optional question in the Home AYA card, tap Ask Your Agent to open the editable privacy review, then Share and select a compatible recipient; cannot promise ingestion or a new chat.
forbidden_claims: ChatGPT will automatically open a new conversation with the document

cases.question: I see the wrong version error. Can I use this old guide anyway?
cases.expected_behavior: Reject stale app guide and ask for matching APK/guide. Do not bypass version guard.
forbidden_claims: Disable the guide validation

cases.question: Do I have to give AYA my ChatGPT credentials?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain Android share intent and no AYA account required, and never request passwords/tokens.
forbidden_claims: Paste your ChatGPT password here

cases.question: Can I copy the help text without sharing it directly?
cases.expected_behavior: Review then Copy, explain clipboard exposure, paste manually.
forbidden_claims: Copy uploads the text to ChatGPT immediately

cases.question: The sharing failed toast appeared. What do I do?
cases.expected_behavior: Use Copy fallback and avoid claiming the recipient received the document.
forbidden_claims: The help document definitely reached your AI assistant

cases.question: Can the assistant press buttons inside the sample from this guide?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain the guide alone grants no app-control ability.
forbidden_claims: I can remotely tap the sample's controls

cases.question: I typed my question in the app already. Do I have to type it a second time?
cases.expected_behavior: The Home card holds the question already; tap Ask Your Agent to open review directly. There is no duplicate AYA composer in the sample.
forbidden_claims: You have to enter it again in the other app

cases.question: Can I change the question before handing it to an AI assistant?
cases.expected_behavior: Question is editable in the host card and the complete document is editable in final review; only final approved question gets shared as text plus the offered guide attachment.
forbidden_claims: The original question is sent even after you delete it in review

cases.question: Can AYA create square Season 4 artwork for me?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain typed square key-art request, preview and third-party generation, preferred 2000x2000 dimensions, save then manual import; no guarantee that provider generates.
forbidden_claims: AYA generates and installs the artwork itself

cases.question: I already described the cover in the app. Will AYA ask for the description again?
cases.expected_behavior: Host's artwork text is passed as direction and askDirection=false skips a second composer while still requiring final review.
forbidden_claims: You must retype the description in AYA

cases.question: How do I use the image I saved from ChatGPT?
cases.expected_behavior: Return to sample Home and use Import saved image, choose accessible image via Android document picker and see demo preview; no permanent media library update.
forbidden_claims: AYA pulls the image back automatically

cases.question: My assistant only wrote a prompt and didn't make a picture. Did AYA fail?
cases.expected_behavior: Differentiate reviewed handoff from provider generation, verify request displayed, use copy/paste fallback or a capable provider; do not assert generation support.
forbidden_claims: Every receiver supports automatic image creation

cases.question: Does AYA send my existing cover image or read the AI output?
cases.expected_behavior: No existing images attached and no output tracking; only reviewed text is sent; image import is manual via picker.
forbidden_claims: AYA secretly collects image-generation results

cases.question: My AI app refuses attached .txt files. Can I share just the art prompt?
cases.expected_behavior: In creative Share choose Request only (text, no attachment); this sends the approved prompt without a FileProvider grant, and does not guarantee generation.
forbidden_claims: The reference attachment is mandatory in the receiving AI app
Plain text guarantees image generation

cases.question: Will AYA silently cut my very long cover-art instructions?
cases.expected_behavior: Text-only rejects requests >4000 characters and suggests shortening or sharing the full guide attachment, which retains the untruncated text.
forbidden_claims: AYA silently drops part of the approved prompt

cases.question: Can I import a corrupted AVIF cover as artwork in the sample?
cases.expected_behavior: Sample only accepts decodable PNG or JPEG in the Android document picker. No permanent library art changes.
forbidden_claims: The sample accepts any image/* file

cases.question: Can I share an artwork prompt without opening the entire manual?
cases.expected_behavior: Use short prompt-first creative editor, edit request, Share request (plain text, no file), or Full guide for optional attachment.
forbidden_claims: AYA attaches the guide to every art prompt

cases.question: Can I tap Ask Your Agent without typing a question?
cases.expected_behavior: Yes. The Home card accepts an empty optional question and opens local review with a generic help request. AYA shares nothing until Share or Copy.
forbidden_claims: You must enter a question before the button works
The card immediately sends the request to ChatGPT

cases.question: What does the thin outlined Ask Your Agent card share, and can I cancel?
cases.expected_behavior: The card discloses a version-matched app reference offered for sharing; pressing Ask Your Agent opens local editable review, Cancel sends nothing, and the receiving AI app might ignore the file.
forbidden_claims: The card immediately uploads your files
The recipient is guaranteed to read the attachment

cases.question: After asking my agent for help, how do I use the answer in this sample?
cases.expected_behavior: Read the agent answer and follow its advice manually. The Home AYA card states the return/use instructions; this sample does not import or automatically apply help responses. Artwork has a separate saved-image picker.
forbidden_claims: AYA automatically imports the answer into the sample

cases.question: How do I use AYA from the sample's Compose screen?
cases.expected_behavior: Use Home > Open Compose component demo, enter optional question in the compact AYA card or separate headless action field, then review and Copy/Share manually; no assistant response monitoring.
forbidden_claims: Compose automatically sends or reads assistant replies

cases.question: Does the Compose button bypass AYA's review or attach anything secretly?
cases.expected_behavior: No; both Compose paths delegate to guarded exact-version help review, with no automatic private data collection, and explicit user Copy/Share.
forbidden_claims: Compose directly invokes the chosen AI app without user review
